ns2:course.label: Digital Rendering Techniques
ns2:course.description: Introduce students to techniques for manipulating images and creating renderings using computer rendering and drafting programs. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 125 or permission of instructor.
